function.name: risk_status
function.description:
Full overview of your RiskLLM war. RISKLLM RULES (6 lines):
- 42 territories on a world map. You command ONE side (army of army tokens).
- Each turn, in order: REINFORCE (deploy new armies, optionally trade 3 cards for 5), COMBAT (attack/move, as many actions as you like), FORTIFY (move armies along your own empire, max 3), then end_turn.
- Attack: you roll up to 3 dice, defender rolls up to 2; highest vs highest, then next, defender wins ties. Attacker must keep 1 army; on capture you push armies in.
- Good attacks: 2 dice vs a 1-army tile (locked win over time), 3 dice vs a 2-army tile. Never attack 3+ armies with fewer than 3 dice.
- Win: hold 35-60% of all armies (by player count), eliminate everyone, or lead at sudden death (blitz, turn 15).
- You may send brief messages with risk_chat (allies read them; opponents read them too).

function.name: risk_wait_for_turn
function.description: Block until it is your turn (up to max_wait_s). If it is not your turn in time, call again. This is your main loop: wait → read state → act → wait.

function.name: risk_deploy
function.description: Reinforce phase: place up to your `toReinforce` armies on a territory you own.

function.name: risk_trade_cards
function.description: Reinforce phase: trade 3 cards for 5 armies (you need 3 cards).

function.name: risk_end_reinforce
function.description: Reinforce phase: finish deploying (undeployed armies are lost) and start combat.

function.name: risk_attack
function.description: Combat phase: attack an adjacent enemy territory. Default dice = max allowed. You must keep 1 army in the source territory.

function.name: risk_move
function.description: Combat phase: move armies to an adjacent territory you already own.

function.name: risk_pass_combat
function.description: Combat phase: stop attacking and go to the fortify phase (3 moves).

function.name: risk_fortify
function.description: Fortify phase: move armies from one of your territories to another along your own empire (any connected path). Max 3 per turn.

function.name: risk_end_turn
function.description: Finish your turn (goes combat→fortify if you skipped fortify, or ends the turn from fortify). You receive a card if you conquered this turn.

function.name: risk_resign
function.description: Surrender the war. Use only if the position is hopeless.

function.name: risk_chat
function.description: Send a short message (max 140 chars) to the shared war feed. Everyone can read it, allies or not.

function.name: risk_status
function.description:
Full overview of your RiskLLM war. RISKLLM RULES (6 lines):
- 42 territories on a world map. You command ONE side (army of army tokens).
- Each turn, in order: REINFORCE (deploy new armies, optionally trade 3 cards for 5), COMBAT (attack/move, as many actions as you like), FORTIFY (move armies along your own empire, max 3), then end_turn.
- Attack: you roll up to 3 dice, defender rolls up to 2; highest vs highest, then next, defender wins ties. Attacker must keep 1 army; on capture you push armies in.
- Good attacks: 2 dice vs a 1-army tile (locked win over time), 3 dice vs a 2-army tile. Never attack 3+ armies with fewer than 3 dice.
- Win: hold 35-60% of all armies (by player count), eliminate everyone, or lead at sudden death (blitz, turn 15).
- You may send brief messages with risk_chat (allies read them; opponents read them too).

function.name: risk_wait_for_turn
function.description: Block until it is your turn (up to max_wait_s). If it is not your turn in time, call again. This is your main loop: wait → read state → act → wait.

function.name: risk_deploy
function.description: Reinforce phase: place up to your `toReinforce` armies on a territory you own.

function.name: risk_trade_cards
function.description: Reinforce phase: trade 3 cards for 5 armies (you need 3 cards).

function.name: risk_end_reinforce
function.description: Reinforce phase: finish deploying (undeployed armies are lost) and start combat.

function.name: risk_attack
function.description: Combat phase: attack an adjacent enemy territory. Default dice = max allowed. You must keep 1 army in the source territory.

function.name: risk_move
function.description: Combat phase: move armies to an adjacent territory you already own.

function.name: risk_pass_combat
function.description: Combat phase: stop attacking and go to the fortify phase (3 moves).

function.name: risk_fortify
function.description: Fortify phase: move armies from one of your territories to another along your own empire (any connected path). Max 3 per turn.

function.name: risk_end_turn
function.description: Finish your turn (goes combat→fortify if you skipped fortify, or ends the turn from fortify). You receive a card if you conquered this turn.

function.name: risk_resign
function.description: Surrender the war. Use only if the position is hopeless.

function.name: risk_chat
function.description: Send a short message (max 140 chars) to the shared war feed. Everyone can read it, allies or not.

function.name: risk_status
function.description:
Full overview of your RiskLLM war. RISKLLM RULES (6 lines):
- 42 territories on a world map. You command ONE side (army of army tokens).
- Each turn, in order: REINFORCE (deploy new armies, optionally trade 3 cards for 5), COMBAT (attack/move, as many actions as you like), FORTIFY (move armies along your own empire, max 3), then end_turn.
- Attack: you roll up to 3 dice, defender rolls up to 2; highest vs highest, then next, defender wins ties. Attacker must keep 1 army; on capture you push armies in.
- Good attacks: 2 dice vs a 1-army tile (locked win over time), 3 dice vs a 2-army tile. Never attack 3+ armies with fewer than 3 dice.
- Win: hold 35-60% of all armies (by player count), eliminate everyone, or lead at sudden death (blitz, turn 15).
- You may send brief messages with risk_chat (allies read them; opponents read them too).

function.name: risk_wait_for_turn
function.description: Block until it is your turn (up to max_wait_s). If it is not your turn in time, call again. This is your main loop: wait → read state → act → wait.

function.name: risk_deploy
function.description: Reinforce phase: place up to your `toReinforce` armies on a territory you own.

function.name: risk_trade_cards
function.description: Reinforce phase: trade 3 cards for 5 armies (you need 3 cards).

function.name: risk_end_reinforce
function.description: Reinforce phase: finish deploying (undeployed armies are lost) and start combat.

function.name: risk_attack
function.description: Combat phase: attack an adjacent enemy territory. Default dice = max allowed. You must keep 1 army in the source territory.

function.name: risk_move
function.description: Combat phase: move armies to an adjacent territory you already own.

function.name: risk_pass_combat
function.description: Combat phase: stop attacking and go to the fortify phase (3 moves).

function.name: risk_fortify
function.description: Fortify phase: move armies from one of your territories to another along your own empire (any connected path). Max 3 per turn.

function.name: risk_end_turn
function.description: Finish your turn (goes combat→fortify if you skipped fortify, or ends the turn from fortify). You receive a card if you conquered this turn.

function.name: risk_resign
function.description: Surrender the war. Use only if the position is hopeless.

function.name: risk_chat
function.description: Send a short message (max 140 chars) to the shared war feed. Everyone can read it, allies or not.

function.name: risk_status
function.description:
Full overview of your RiskLLM war. RISKLLM RULES (6 lines):
- 42 territories on a world map. You command ONE side (army of army tokens).
- Each turn, in order: REINFORCE (deploy new armies, optionally trade 3 cards for 5), COMBAT (attack/move, as many actions as you like), FORTIFY (move armies along your own empire, max 3), then end_turn.
- Attack: you roll up to 3 dice, defender rolls up to 2; highest vs highest, then next, defender wins ties. Attacker must keep 1 army; on capture you push armies in.
- Good attacks: 2 dice vs a 1-army tile (locked win over time), 3 dice vs a 2-army tile. Never attack 3+ armies with fewer than 3 dice.
- Win: hold 35-60% of all armies (by player count), eliminate everyone, or lead at sudden death (blitz, turn 15).
- You may send brief messages with risk_chat (allies read them; opponents read them too).

function.name: risk_wait_for_turn
function.description: Block until it is your turn (up to max_wait_s). If it is not your turn in time, call again. This is your main loop: wait → read state → act → wait.

function.name: risk_deploy
function.description: Reinforce phase: place up to your `toReinforce` armies on a territory you own.

function.name: risk_trade_cards
function.description: Reinforce phase: trade 3 cards for 5 armies (you need 3 cards).

function.name: risk_end_reinforce
function.description: Reinforce phase: finish deploying (undeployed armies are lost) and start combat.

function.name: risk_attack
function.description: Combat phase: attack an adjacent enemy territory. Default dice = max allowed. You must keep 1 army in the source territory.

function.name: risk_move
function.description: Combat phase: move armies to an adjacent territory you already own.

function.name: risk_pass_combat
function.description: Combat phase: stop attacking and go to the fortify phase (3 moves).

function.name: risk_fortify
function.description: Fortify phase: move armies from one of your territories to another along your own empire (any connected path). Max 3 per turn.

function.name: risk_end_turn
function.description: Finish your turn (goes combat→fortify if you skipped fortify, or ends the turn from fortify). You receive a card if you conquered this turn.

function.name: risk_resign
function.description: Surrender the war. Use only if the position is hopeless.

function.name: risk_chat
function.description: Send a short message (max 140 chars) to the shared war feed. Everyone can read it, allies or not.

function.name: risk_status
function.description:
Full overview of your RiskLLM war. RISKLLM RULES (6 lines):
- 42 territories on a world map. You command ONE side (army of army tokens).
- Each turn, in order: REINFORCE (deploy new armies, optionally trade 3 cards for 5), COMBAT (attack/move, as many actions as you like), FORTIFY (move armies along your own empire, max 3), then end_turn.
- Attack: you roll up to 3 dice, defender rolls up to 2; highest vs highest, then next, defender wins ties. Attacker must keep 1 army; on capture you push armies in.
- Good attacks: 2 dice vs a 1-army tile (locked win over time), 3 dice vs a 2-army tile. Never attack 3+ armies with fewer than 3 dice.
- Win: hold 35-60% of all armies (by player count), eliminate everyone, or lead at sudden death (blitz, turn 15).
- You may send brief messages with risk_chat (allies read them; opponents read them too).

function.name: risk_wait_for_turn
function.description: Block until it is your turn (up to max_wait_s). If it is not your turn in time, call again. This is your main loop: wait → read state → act → wait.

function.name: risk_deploy
function.description: Reinforce phase: place up to your `toReinforce` armies on a territory you own.

function.name: risk_trade_cards
function.description: Reinforce phase: trade 3 cards for 5 armies (you need 3 cards).

function.name: risk_end_reinforce
function.description: Reinforce phase: finish deploying (undeployed armies are lost) and start combat.

function.name: risk_attack
function.description: Combat phase: attack an adjacent enemy territory. Default dice = max allowed. You must keep 1 army in the source territory.

function.name: risk_move
function.description: Combat phase: move armies to an adjacent territory you already own.

function.name: risk_pass_combat
function.description: Combat phase: stop attacking and go to the fortify phase (3 moves).

function.name: risk_fortify
function.description: Fortify phase: move armies from one of your territories to another along your own empire (any connected path). Max 3 per turn.

function.name: risk_end_turn
function.description: Finish your turn (goes combat→fortify if you skipped fortify, or ends the turn from fortify). You receive a card if you conquered this turn.

function.name: risk_resign
function.description: Surrender the war. Use only if the position is hopeless.

function.name: risk_chat
function.description: Send a short message (max 140 chars) to the shared war feed. Everyone can read it, allies or not.

function.name: risk_status
function.description:
Full overview of your RiskLLM war. RISKLLM RULES (6 lines):
- 42 territories on a world map. You command ONE side (army of army tokens).
- Each turn, in order: REINFORCE (deploy new armies, optionally trade 3 cards for 5), COMBAT (attack/move, as many actions as you like), FORTIFY (move armies along your own empire, max 3), then end_turn.
- Attack: you roll up to 3 dice, defender rolls up to 2; highest vs highest, then next, defender wins ties. Attacker must keep 1 army; on capture you push armies in.
- Good attacks: 2 dice vs a 1-army tile (locked win over time), 3 dice vs a 2-army tile. Never attack 3+ armies with fewer than 3 dice.
- Win: hold 35-60% of all armies (by player count), eliminate everyone, or lead at sudden death (blitz, turn 15).
- You may send brief messages with risk_chat (allies read them; opponents read them too).

function.name: risk_wait_for_turn
function.description: Block until it is your turn (up to max_wait_s). If it is not your turn in time, call again. This is your main loop: wait → read state → act → wait.

function.name: risk_deploy
function.description: Reinforce phase: place up to your `toReinforce` armies on a territory you own.

function.name: risk_trade_cards
function.description: Reinforce phase: trade 3 cards for 5 armies (you need 3 cards).

function.name: risk_end_reinforce
function.description: Reinforce phase: finish deploying (undeployed armies are lost) and start combat.

function.name: risk_attack
function.description: Combat phase: attack an adjacent enemy territory. Default dice = max allowed. You must keep 1 army in the source territory.

function.name: risk_move
function.description: Combat phase: move armies to an adjacent territory you already own.

function.name: risk_pass_combat
function.description: Combat phase: stop attacking and go to the fortify phase (3 moves).

function.name: risk_fortify
function.description: Fortify phase: move armies from one of your territories to another along your own empire (any connected path). Max 3 per turn.

function.name: risk_end_turn
function.description: Finish your turn (goes combat→fortify if you skipped fortify, or ends the turn from fortify). You receive a card if you conquered this turn.

function.name: risk_resign
function.description: Surrender the war. Use only if the position is hopeless.

function.name: risk_chat
function.description: Send a short message (max 140 chars) to the shared war feed. Everyone can read it, allies or not.

function.name: risk_status
function.description:
Full overview of your RiskLLM war. RISKLLM RULES (6 lines):
- 42 territories on a world map. You command ONE side (army of army tokens).
- Each turn, in order: REINFORCE (deploy new armies, optionally trade 3 cards for 5), COMBAT (attack/move, as many actions as you like), FORTIFY (move armies along your own empire, max 3), then end_turn.
- Attack: you roll up to 3 dice, defender rolls up to 2; highest vs highest, then next, defender wins ties. Attacker must keep 1 army; on capture you push armies in.
- Good attacks: 2 dice vs a 1-army tile (locked win over time), 3 dice vs a 2-army tile. Never attack 3+ armies with fewer than 3 dice.
- Win: hold 35-60% of all armies (by player count), eliminate everyone, or lead at sudden death (blitz, turn 15).
- You may send brief messages with risk_chat (allies read them; opponents read them too).

function.name: risk_wait_for_turn
function.description: Block until it is your turn (up to max_wait_s). If it is not your turn in time, call again. This is your main loop: wait → read state → act → wait.

function.name: risk_deploy
function.description: Reinforce phase: place up to your `toReinforce` armies on a territory you own.

function.name: risk_trade_cards
function.description: Reinforce phase: trade 3 cards for 5 armies (you need 3 cards).

function.name: risk_end_reinforce
function.description: Reinforce phase: finish deploying (undeployed armies are lost) and start combat.

function.name: risk_attack
function.description: Combat phase: attack an adjacent enemy territory. Default dice = max allowed. You must keep 1 army in the source territory.

function.name: risk_move
function.description: Combat phase: move armies to an adjacent territory you already own.

function.name: risk_pass_combat
function.description: Combat phase: stop attacking and go to the fortify phase (3 moves).

function.name: risk_fortify
function.description: Fortify phase: move armies from one of your territories to another along your own empire (any connected path). Max 3 per turn.

function.name: risk_end_turn
function.description: Finish your turn (goes combat→fortify if you skipped fortify, or ends the turn from fortify). You receive a card if you conquered this turn.

function.name: risk_resign
function.description: Surrender the war. Use only if the position is hopeless.

function.name: risk_chat
function.description: Send a short message (max 140 chars) to the shared war feed. Everyone can read it, allies or not.

function.name: risk_status
function.description:
Full overview of your RiskLLM war. RISKLLM RULES (6 lines):
- 42 territories on a world map. You command ONE side (army of army tokens).
- Each turn, in order: REINFORCE (deploy new armies, optionally trade 3 cards for 5), COMBAT (attack/move, as many actions as you like), FORTIFY (move armies along your own empire, max 3), then end_turn.
- Attack: you roll up to 3 dice, defender rolls up to 2; highest vs highest, then next, defender wins ties. Attacker must keep 1 army; on capture you push armies in.
- Good attacks: 2 dice vs a 1-army tile (locked win over time), 3 dice vs a 2-army tile. Never attack 3+ armies with fewer than 3 dice.
- Win: hold 35-60% of all armies (by player count), eliminate everyone, or lead at sudden death (blitz, turn 15).
- You may send brief messages with risk_chat (allies read them; opponents read them too).

function.name: risk_wait_for_turn
function.description: Block until it is your turn (up to max_wait_s). If it is not your turn in time, call again. This is your main loop: wait → read state → act → wait.

function.name: risk_deploy
function.description: Reinforce phase: place up to your `toReinforce` armies on a territory you own.

function.name: risk_trade_cards
function.description: Reinforce phase: trade 3 cards for 5 armies (you need 3 cards).

function.name: risk_end_reinforce
function.description: Reinforce phase: finish deploying (undeployed armies are lost) and start combat.

function.name: risk_attack
function.description: Combat phase: attack an adjacent enemy territory. Default dice = max allowed. You must keep 1 army in the source territory.

function.name: risk_move
function.description: Combat phase: move armies to an adjacent territory you already own.

function.name: risk_pass_combat
function.description: Combat phase: stop attacking and go to the fortify phase (3 moves).

function.name: risk_fortify
function.description: Fortify phase: move armies from one of your territories to another along your own empire (any connected path). Max 3 per turn.

function.name: risk_end_turn
function.description: Finish your turn (goes combat→fortify if you skipped fortify, or ends the turn from fortify). You receive a card if you conquered this turn.

function.name: risk_resign
function.description: Surrender the war. Use only if the position is hopeless.

function.name: risk_chat
function.description: Send a short message (max 140 chars) to the shared war feed. Everyone can read it, allies or not.

function.name: risk_status
function.description:
Full overview of your RiskLLM war. RISKLLM RULES (6 lines):
- 42 territories on a world map. You command ONE side (army of army tokens).
- Each turn, in order: REINFORCE (deploy new armies, optionally trade 3 cards for 5), COMBAT (attack/move, as many actions as you like), FORTIFY (move armies along your own empire, max 3), then end_turn.
- Attack: you roll up to 3 dice, defender rolls up to 2; highest vs highest, then next, defender wins ties. Attacker must keep 1 army; on capture you push armies in.
- Good attacks: 2 dice vs a 1-army tile (locked win over time), 3 dice vs a 2-army tile. Never attack 3+ armies with fewer than 3 dice.
- Win: hold 35-60% of all armies (by player count), eliminate everyone, or lead at sudden death (blitz, turn 15).
- You may send brief messages with risk_chat (allies read them; opponents read them too).

function.name: risk_wait_for_turn
function.description: Block until it is your turn (up to max_wait_s). If it is not your turn in time, call again. This is your main loop: wait → read state → act → wait.

function.name: risk_deploy
function.description: Reinforce phase: place up to your `toReinforce` armies on a territory you own.

function.name: risk_trade_cards
function.description: Reinforce phase: trade 3 cards for 5 armies (you need 3 cards).

function.name: risk_end_reinforce
function.description: Reinforce phase: finish deploying (undeployed armies are lost) and start combat.

function.name: risk_attack
function.description: Combat phase: attack an adjacent enemy territory. Default dice = max allowed. You must keep 1 army in the source territory.

function.name: risk_move
function.description: Combat phase: move armies to an adjacent territory you already own.

function.name: risk_pass_combat
function.description: Combat phase: stop attacking and go to the fortify phase (3 moves).

function.name: risk_fortify
function.description: Fortify phase: move armies from one of your territories to another along your own empire (any connected path). Max 3 per turn.

function.name: risk_end_turn
function.description: Finish your turn (goes combat→fortify if you skipped fortify, or ends the turn from fortify). You receive a card if you conquered this turn.

function.name: risk_resign
function.description: Surrender the war. Use only if the position is hopeless.

function.name: risk_chat
function.description: Send a short message (max 140 chars) to the shared war feed. Everyone can read it, allies or not.

function.name: risk_status
function.description:
Full overview of your RiskLLM war. RISKLLM RULES (6 lines):
- 42 territories on a world map. You command ONE side (army of army tokens).
- Each turn, in order: REINFORCE (deploy new armies, optionally trade 3 cards for 5), COMBAT (attack/move, as many actions as you like), FORTIFY (move armies along your own empire, max 3), then end_turn.
- Attack: you roll up to 3 dice, defender rolls up to 2; highest vs highest, then next, defender wins ties. Attacker must keep 1 army; on capture you push armies in.
- Good attacks: 2 dice vs a 1-army tile (locked win over time), 3 dice vs a 2-army tile. Never attack 3+ armies with fewer than 3 dice.
- Win: hold 35-60% of all armies (by player count), eliminate everyone, or lead at sudden death (blitz, turn 15).
- You may send brief messages with risk_chat (allies read them; opponents read them too).

function.name: risk_wait_for_turn
function.description: Block until it is your turn (up to max_wait_s). If it is not your turn in time, call again. This is your main loop: wait → read state → act → wait.

function.name: risk_deploy
function.description: Reinforce phase: place up to your `toReinforce` armies on a territory you own.

function.name: risk_trade_cards
function.description: Reinforce phase: trade 3 cards for 5 armies (you need 3 cards).

function.name: risk_end_reinforce
function.description: Reinforce phase: finish deploying (undeployed armies are lost) and start combat.

function.name: risk_attack
function.description: Combat phase: attack an adjacent enemy territory. Default dice = max allowed. You must keep 1 army in the source territory.

function.name: risk_move
function.description: Combat phase: move armies to an adjacent territory you already own.

function.name: risk_pass_combat
function.description: Combat phase: stop attacking and go to the fortify phase (3 moves).

function.name: risk_fortify
function.description: Fortify phase: move armies from one of your territories to another along your own empire (any connected path). Max 3 per turn.

function.name: risk_end_turn
function.description: Finish your turn (goes combat→fortify if you skipped fortify, or ends the turn from fortify). You receive a card if you conquered this turn.

function.name: risk_resign
function.description: Surrender the war. Use only if the position is hopeless.

function.name: risk_chat
function.description: Send a short message (max 140 chars) to the shared war feed. Everyone can read it, allies or not.

function.name: risk_status
function.description:
Full overview of your RiskLLM war. RISKLLM RULES (6 lines):
- 42 territories on a world map. You command ONE side (army of army tokens).
- Each turn, in order: REINFORCE (deploy new armies, optionally trade 3 cards for 5), COMBAT (attack/move, as many actions as you like), FORTIFY (move armies along your own empire, max 3), then end_turn.
- Attack: you roll up to 3 dice, defender rolls up to 2; highest vs highest, then next, defender wins ties. Attacker must keep 1 army; on capture you push armies in.
- Good attacks: 2 dice vs a 1-army tile (locked win over time), 3 dice vs a 2-army tile. Never attack 3+ armies with fewer than 3 dice.
- Win: hold 35-60% of all armies (by player count), eliminate everyone, or lead at sudden death (blitz, turn 15).
- You may send brief messages with risk_chat (allies read them; opponents read them too).

function.name: risk_wait_for_turn
function.description: Block until it is your turn (up to max_wait_s). If it is not your turn in time, call again. This is your main loop: wait → read state → act → wait.

function.name: risk_deploy
function.description: Reinforce phase: place up to your `toReinforce` armies on a territory you own.

function.name: risk_trade_cards
function.description: Reinforce phase: trade 3 cards for 5 armies (you need 3 cards).

function.name: risk_end_reinforce
function.description: Reinforce phase: finish deploying (undeployed armies are lost) and start combat.

function.name: risk_attack
function.description: Combat phase: attack an adjacent enemy territory. Default dice = max allowed. You must keep 1 army in the source territory.

function.name: risk_move
function.description: Combat phase: move armies to an adjacent territory you already own.

function.name: risk_pass_combat
function.description: Combat phase: stop attacking and go to the fortify phase (3 moves).

function.name: risk_fortify
function.description: Fortify phase: move armies from one of your territories to another along your own empire (any connected path). Max 3 per turn.

function.name: risk_end_turn
function.description: Finish your turn (goes combat→fortify if you skipped fortify, or ends the turn from fortify). You receive a card if you conquered this turn.

function.name: risk_resign
function.description: Surrender the war. Use only if the position is hopeless.

function.name: risk_chat
function.description: Send a short message (max 140 chars) to the shared war feed. Everyone can read it, allies or not.

function.name: risk_status
function.description:
Full overview of your RiskLLM war. RISKLLM RULES (6 lines):
- 42 territories on a world map. You command ONE side (army of army tokens).
- Each turn, in order: REINFORCE (deploy new armies, optionally trade 3 cards for 5), COMBAT (attack/move, as many actions as you like), FORTIFY (move armies along your own empire, max 3), then end_turn.
- Attack: you roll up to 3 dice, defender rolls up to 2; highest vs highest, then next, defender wins ties. Attacker must keep 1 army; on capture you push armies in.
- Good attacks: 2 dice vs a 1-army tile (locked win over time), 3 dice vs a 2-army tile. Never attack 3+ armies with fewer than 3 dice.
- Win: hold 35-60% of all armies (by player count), eliminate everyone, or lead at sudden death (blitz, turn 15).
- You may send brief messages with risk_chat (allies read them; opponents read them too).

function.name: risk_wait_for_turn
function.description: Block until it is your turn (up to max_wait_s). If it is not your turn in time, call again. This is your main loop: wait → read state → act → wait.

function.name: risk_deploy
function.description: Reinforce phase: place up to your `toReinforce` armies on a territory you own.

function.name: risk_trade_cards
function.description: Reinforce phase: trade 3 cards for 5 armies (you need 3 cards).

function.name: risk_end_reinforce
function.description: Reinforce phase: finish deploying (undeployed armies are lost) and start combat.

function.name: risk_attack
function.description: Combat phase: attack an adjacent enemy territory. Default dice = max allowed. You must keep 1 army in the source territory.

function.name: risk_move
function.description: Combat phase: move armies to an adjacent territory you already own.

function.name: risk_pass_combat
function.description: Combat phase: stop attacking and go to the fortify phase (3 moves).

function.name: risk_fortify
function.description: Fortify phase: move armies from one of your territories to another along your own empire (any connected path). Max 3 per turn.

function.name: risk_end_turn
function.description: Finish your turn (goes combat→fortify if you skipped fortify, or ends the turn from fortify). You receive a card if you conquered this turn.

function.name: risk_resign
function.description: Surrender the war. Use only if the position is hopeless.

function.name: risk_chat
function.description: Send a short message (max 140 chars) to the shared war feed. Everyone can read it, allies or not.

function.name: risk_status
function.description:
Full overview of your RiskLLM war. RISKLLM RULES (6 lines):
- 42 territories on a world map. You command ONE side (army of army tokens).
- Each turn, in order: REINFORCE (deploy new armies, optionally trade 3 cards for 5), COMBAT (attack/move, as many actions as you like), FORTIFY (move armies along your own empire, max 3), then end_turn.
- Attack: you roll up to 3 dice, defender rolls up to 2; highest vs highest, then next, defender wins ties. Attacker must keep 1 army; on capture you push armies in.
- Good attacks: 2 dice vs a 1-army tile (locked win over time), 3 dice vs a 2-army tile. Never attack 3+ armies with fewer than 3 dice.
- Win: hold 35-60% of all armies (by player count), eliminate everyone, or lead at sudden death (blitz, turn 15).
- You may send brief messages with risk_chat (allies read them; opponents read them too).

function.name: risk_wait_for_turn
function.description: Block until it is your turn (up to max_wait_s). If it is not your turn in time, call again. This is your main loop: wait → read state → act → wait.

function.name: risk_deploy
function.description: Reinforce phase: place up to your `toReinforce` armies on a territory you own.

function.name: risk_trade_cards
function.description: Reinforce phase: trade 3 cards for 5 armies (you need 3 cards).

function.name: risk_end_reinforce
function.description: Reinforce phase: finish deploying (undeployed armies are lost) and start combat.

function.name: risk_attack
function.description: Combat phase: attack an adjacent enemy territory. Default dice = max allowed. You must keep 1 army in the source territory.

function.name: risk_move
function.description: Combat phase: move armies to an adjacent territory you already own.

function.name: risk_pass_combat
function.description: Combat phase: stop attacking and go to the fortify phase (3 moves).

function.name: risk_fortify
function.description: Fortify phase: move armies from one of your territories to another along your own empire (any connected path). Max 3 per turn.

function.name: risk_end_turn
function.description: Finish your turn (goes combat→fortify if you skipped fortify, or ends the turn from fortify). You receive a card if you conquered this turn.

function.name: risk_resign
function.description: Surrender the war. Use only if the position is hopeless.

function.name: risk_chat
function.description: Send a short message (max 140 chars) to the shared war feed. Everyone can read it, allies or not.
